Homes.nameHint: Everyone in this Home sees this name. Up to {max} characters.

Homes.nameInvalid: Use at least one visible letter, number or symbol, and no invisible or text-direction characters.
Homes.timeZoneHint: Home schedules, such as shared chores and events, follow this timezone, whoever looks at them and wherever they are.
Homes.timeZoneInvalid: Choose a timezone from the list.

Settings.displayNameHint: How Madeora addresses you. Up to {max} characters; leave it empty to have none.
Settings.displayNameInvalid: Use at least one visible letter, number or symbol, and no control or text-direction characters.
Settings.saveSignedOut: You're signed out. Sign in again to save this change.
Settings.saveInvalid: This change couldn't be saved. Check the values and try again.

Settings.saveFailed: Something went wrong while saving. Please try again.
Settings.loadFailed: Your saved preferences couldn't be loaded, so defaults are shown. Saving may not work right now; try again later.
Settings.languageAndRegionHint: Saved to your account and used on all your devices. They change how things are shown, never what is saved.
Settings.savedOnAccount: Saved to your account and used on all your devices.
Settings.regionalAutomaticHint: Based on your browser's language and region.

Settings.signInMethodsHint: The ways you can sign in to your account. Only you can see this.

Auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words work well.
Auth.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
Auth.passwordTooLong: Use at most 72 characters (fewer with accents or emoji).
Auth.passwordIsEmail: Your password can't be your email address.
Auth.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
Auth.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email address first. Check your inbox, or send the email again below.
Auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
Auth.weakPassword: This password isn't allowed. Choose a longer one.
Auth.samePassword: Choose a password that is different from your current one.
Auth.linkInvalid: This link has expired or has already been used.
Auth.network: Madeora can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
Auth.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Auth.captchaFailed: The security check didn't go through. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
Auth.captchaUnavailable: The security check couldn't load. Check your connection, turn off any blocker for challenges.cloudflare.com, and reload the page.
Auth.signUpClosed: New accounts can't be created here yet.
Auth.passwordChangedNotice: Your password has been changed and every device was signed out. Sign in with your new password.
Auth.checkEmailDescription: If {email} can be used for a new account, we've sent it a link to confirm it. Open the link on any device to finish.
Auth.checkEmailSpam: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or send the email again.
Auth.resendSent: If an account with that address still needs confirming, we've sent a new link.
Auth.confirmDescription: Select the button to confirm your address and open Madeora.
Auth.confirmMissingToken: This confirmation link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one below.
Auth.forgotDescription: Enter the email address of your account. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
Auth.forgotSent: If there's a Madeora account for {email}, we've sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works once and expires after an hour.
Auth.resetDescription: When you save it, every device signed in to your account is signed out, this one included. Then you sign in again with the new password.
Auth.resetMissingToken: This reset link is incomplete or has expired. Ask for a new one.
Auth.signOutEverywhereFailed: Your password was changed and your other devices were signed out, but this browser's reset could not be closed yet. Try again to finish.
Auth.googleCancelled: Signing in with Google was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
Auth.googleExpired: This Google sign-in has expired or was already used. Please start again.
Auth.googleFailed: Signing in with Google didn't work. If you already have a Madeora account, sign in with your email and password, then link Google under Settings › Sign-in methods.
Auth.googleUnavailable: Signing in with Google isn't available right now. Please use your email and password.

SignInMethods.passwordSet: Set up. You can sign in with your email address and password.
SignInMethods.passwordNotSetHint: Adding a password to an account created with Google comes in a later version of Madeora.
SignInMethods.googleNotOffered: Google sign-in isn't switched on here yet.
SignInMethods.googleConnected: Linked. You can sign in with Google.
SignInMethods.lastMethodHint: Google is your only way to sign in, so it can't be unlinked.
SignInMethods.linkExplanation: Google will be linked to your Madeora account {email}. Confirm your password first; Google then asks which Google account to use.
SignInMethods.unlinkExplanation: After unlinking, you can no longer sign in with Google. You keep signing in with your email address and password.
SignInMethods.currentPasswordHint: To protect your account, confirm it's you.
SignInMethods.linkedNotice: Google is linked. You can now sign in with Google or with your email and password.
SignInMethods.unlinkedNotice: Google is unlinked. Sign in with your email address and password from now on.
SignInMethods.notAllowed: This change isn't allowed, so your sign-in methods were not changed.
SignInMethods.unavailable: Linking sign-in methods isn't available right now. Please try again later.
SignInMethods.linkCancelled: Linking Google was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
SignInMethods.linkExpired: This link request has expired or was already used. Please start again from Settings.
SignInMethods.linkAlreadyLinked: This Google account can't be linked. It may already be used to sign in to another Madeora account.
SignInMethods.linkFailed: Google couldn't be linked. Nothing was changed. Please try again.
SignInMethods.linkAccountChanged: This browser is now signed in to a different account than the one that started linking Google. Nothing was changed for the account you are using now.
